description: Features: 1. Supports up to 20 axes 2. Customizable maximum value for each axis (auto-set by default) 3. Color settings available for each series. 4.Clear layout and easy-to-read labels 5.Seamless integration into Power BI reports Recommended Use Cases: A: Comparing employee skill levels B: Evaluating product features C: Comparing team performance D: Analyzing trends in customer satisfaction across categories
